chunks: Simply because he possesses wealth and children.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when someone is described as having wealth and children in this context?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the worldly metrics of success often cited by the polytheists of Mecca, contrasting material abundance with spiritual guidance. It reflects the socio-economic reality where lineage and wealth were primary indicators of status, a theme frequently critiqued in the Quran as distinct from true piety. This context highlights the divine perspective that values faith over mere accumulation of resources and progeny.
